name: lildocs
description: A lightweight CLI that turns Markdown docs into a static searchable documentation site.

scripts.docs:serve: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.mjs build ./docs --out ./dist/docs && sirv ./dist/docs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts schemas package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .prettierrc.json .vscode/settings.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts schemas package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .prettierrc.json .vscode/settings.json
